changelog: 🦀 Upgraded Background Daemon to Rust (`agy_ide_bridge_rs`): Instant sub-millisecond cold boot, zero garbage collection pauses, and ~90% lower RAM footprint (5.2 MB RSS vs. 45 MB).
⚡ Compact Binary Footprint: Shrunk daemon binary from 12.6 MB down to 1.5 MB uncompressed and 816 KB xz-compressed inside the APK.
🚀 Complete REST & WebSocket Parity: High-performance async Tokio + Axum engine handling file operations, Git source control, project templates, transcript parsing, and MCP server bridges.
🛡️ Rock-Solid Memory Safety & Graceful Shutdown: Thread-safe broadcast bus, zero-copy streaming, and resilient fallback mechanisms.
